Text-bearing subject terms such as phrase, note, notebook, page, document, tag, label, typography, editorial layout or idea table require prompt_review text_risk_mitigation and should be translated into blank cards, pure material surfaces, color fields, light paths, object arrays or geometric hierarchy before GPU generation.

wan_policy.extension_policy: If the chosen scene stays on screen longer than the generated Wan clip, Remotion extends the motion with playbackRate, tail hold and subtle still motion rather than requesting a longer Wan generation.
